## Product-Side Optimization Round 1 — Summary

### Changes Made (3 files modified, 1 new file)

**1. New script: `structure-manager/scripts/build_gamma_al2o3.py`** (HIGH IMPACT → SC_struct_008)
- Deterministic γ-Al2O3 defective spinel builder using Pinto/Digne Fd-3m model
- Builds complete structure in ONE script call: Wyckoff expansion → vacancy removal (greedy max-spacing) → validation
- Eliminates 3-5 turns of manual reasoning the agent previously spent on multi-step Wyckoff construction
- Tested: produces correct Al₂₁O₃₂ (ratio 0.656 ≈ 2/3 ✓), both tet/oct Al environments, cubic 90° angles

**2. Slimmed `mcp-mat-sg/SKILL.md`** (NET -7 lines)
- γ-Al2O3 section: replaced 15-line manual procedure with 6-line script reference
- Passivation: "Preferred" → "**MANDATORY**" + "Do NOT write custom passivation scripts from scratch" (addresses SC_struct_SiH where agent wrote 198-line custom script instead of using provided `passivate_surface.py`)
- Ordered replicas: added timeout-aware finish directive — "Delivered files with brief grounding > perfect grounding with no deliverable" (addresses SC_struct_005 where agent timed out after generating all files but before finishing)

**3. HT pipeline time budget** (`tasker-polar-surface/reference/ht_screening_pipeline.md`, +6 lines)
- Added "Time Budget (anti-timeout)" section: 1 turn plan, 1 turn write consolidated script, 1 turn execute
- Addresses CR_BP_HT_adsorption_tree where agent spent 28k reasoning tokens in a single turn planning before executing

### Expected Impact by Task
| Task | Current | Expected | Mechanism |
|------|---------|----------|-----------|
| SC_struct_008 (γ-Al2O3) | 36 | 70-87 | Script eliminates manual construction + calculator search waste |
| SC_struct_005 (disordered) | 50 | 70-80 | Timeout-aware finish: files already exist, just need to complete |
| SC_struct_SiH (passivation) | 50 | 60-80 | MANDATORY directive prevents custom script waste (infra error still a risk) |
| CR_BP_HT_adsorption | 67 | 75-85 | Time budget reduces 28k-token reasoning overhead |
| CR_WO_Ag_adsorption | 33 | 33 | Network error — cannot fix product-side |

### Prompt Budget
- Before: within budget; After: 5590 tokens (target 12000, max 15000) ✓
- Net SKILL.md line change: **-7 lines** (net negative ✓)

### Not Changed (by design)
- **No PM skill created** — historical lesson shows PM skill causes regression
- **No `matmaster/exps/` changes** — all fixes are at skill/tool layer
- **High-scoring tasks protected** — no changes affect BP_elec_001, BP_struct_003/004, CR_SC_ZnPd011, PM_proj_003/006, SC_elec_004, SC_struct_004/009/hetero, IG_abacus_008
